description: This file contains shell script functions used for managing documentation and command validation within a software project, specifically for extracting variables from a Makefile, checking for missing documentation, and verifying extraneous documentation entries.

methods.name: extract_variable
methods.description: Function to extract variable values from the Makefile by capturing output of make commands and processing with sed.

methods.name: check_missing_docs
methods.description: Function that verifies each command in $ALL_COMMANDS has a corresponding documentation file and link.

methods.name: check_extraneous_docs
methods.description: Function that detects documentation entries in the command list that are not referenced in the man pages.
